items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And they were doing -- I think they were doing -- starting the Stormy Weather Review there with Ethel Waters. And this was a gas.

ctx.x: So now that very next week we opened the Cotton Club.
And they were doing -- I think they were doing -- starting the Stormy Weather Review there with Ethel Waters. And this was a gas.

I mean, we were broadcasting every night. And now in those days we used to do 14 weeks right here in New York of theater during the day, while playing at the Cotton Club. You know, we'd play the Harlem Opera House and then we'd play the theater down here on 14th Street.
